bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
compose="$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
current="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
tagged="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
old="sha256:9cc3afe33bf90e59dda71c2ca1fa8214a671e7af4aba90a1dc823dfc4310d6a3"
intermediate="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-visible-error-f189753 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
test "$current" = "$tagged" || exit 70
if test "$current" != "$old" && test "$current" != "$intermediate"; then exit 71;fi
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" && test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)";trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 43562679636 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp" >/dev/null
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "5670ab7f3629e711266a128281095171e2d6ed9c65899d235f344790bcaeab4e" || exit 72
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$tmp/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-screen-7336082 -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-screen-7336082 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
candidate="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-screen-7336082)"
printf 'secrets:\n  db_password:\n    file: %s\n  bot_token:\n    file: %s\n' "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" > "$tmp/override.yaml"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" config -q >/dev/null
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-7336082
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-screen-7336082 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback(){ docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-7336082 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local;docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null;then rollback;exit 81;fi
sleep 5
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
if test "$actual" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true;then rollback;exit 82;fi
{ echo PROFILE_CLICKED_SCREEN_DEPLOY=PASS;echo SOURCE_HEAD=733608281f13f6d2f44768a90bfb6b87d09ef79d;echo IMAGE="$actual";echo RUNNING=true; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
